name: HailoRT (Hailo AI Software Suite runtime)
design_goal: run Dataflow-Compiler-produced .hef binaries on Hailo-8/8L/10H NPUs
low-latency edge inference with on-die model memory
notable_features: HEF binaries embed the quantized network + memory map; no general tensor-op interpreter
generative-AI (LLM) path exists only on Hailo-10H
hardware_caveats: Hailo-8/8L cannot run transformer-decode LLMs - vision CNNs only
model must be compiled through the licensed Dataflow Compiler (ONNX -> HAR -> optimize -> HEF)
notes: Engine record created 2026-10-15 to back Hailo-8 Model-Zoo benchmark rows. hailort GitHub repo hosts the runtime source; DFC toolchain is proprietary/licensed.
